WITH order_status_values AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT status
  FROM public.orders
  WHERE status IS NOT NULL
), relationship_checks AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.orders o LEFT JOIN public.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.customer_id IS NULL) AS unmatched_orders,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.refunds r LEFT JOIN public.orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL) AS unmatched_refunds,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.orders WHERE amount <= 0) AS nonpositive_order_amounts,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.refunds WHERE refund_amount <= 0) AS nonpositive_refund_amounts,
    (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(refund_count), 0) FROM (
       SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS refund_count
       FROM public.refunds
       GROUP BY order_id
     ) refund_counts) AS max_refunds_per_order
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(status ORDER BY status), '[]'::json) FROM order_status_values) AS statuses,
  unmatched_orders,
  unmatched_refunds,
  nonpositive_order_amounts,
  nonpositive_refund_amounts,
  max_refunds_per_order
FROM relationship_checks;

  SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS refund_count
  FROM public.refunds
  GROUP BY order_id

  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.refunds WHERE refund_amount <= 0) AS nonpositive_refund_amounts,
  (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(refund_count), 0) FROM refund_counts) AS max_refunds_per_order;

SELECT DISTINCT
  o.status,
  CASE
    WHEN r.refund_id IS NULL THEN 'no_refund'
    ELSE 'has_refund'
  END AS refund_presence,
  CASE
    WHEN r.refund_id IS NULL THEN 'not_applicable'
    WHEN r.refund_amount = o.amount THEN 'same_as_order_amount'
    WHEN r.refund_amount < o.amount THEN 'less_than_order_amount'
    ELSE 'greater_than_order_amount'
  END AS refund_amount_relation
FROM public.orders o
LEFT JOIN public.refunds r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
ORDER BY o.status, refund_presence, refund_amount_relation;
